summary: Verified backend contract for mobile measurement ack lifecycle. All 5 pytest cases pass: (1) POST /api/mobile/measurements returns 201 with authoritative revision containing id, updated_at, revision_number, editable, structures/facets/edges/penetrations arrays and summary; (2) Idempotent replay with same Idempotency-Key returns same revision id and replayed:true; (3) LIST by property_id and GET by id return the authoritative revision (matching id + updated_at); (4) PUT with correct If-Match returns 200 and advances updated_at (new authoritative token); (5) PUT with STALE If-Match returns 409 whose detail is an OBJECT containing server key holding the current authoritative revision (with matching id and current updated_at). The contract the mobile _reconcileMeasurementAcks / resolveMeasurementView relies on is intact.
critical_code_review_comments: mobile.py update_measurement (line 280) correctly returns 409 with detail={message, server: jsonable_encoder(out)} — matches mobile client expectation of pendingUpdate.serverValue.
create_measurement idempotency replay path (lines 253-258) returns replayed:true and the same id as expected.
seed_data_creation: Created a TEST_ prefixed property and multiple measurement revisions attached to it via /api/properties and /api/mobile/measurements.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend measurement ack contract verified via /app/backend/tests/test_mobile_measurements_ack.py. Run: pytest backend/tests/test_mobile_measurements_ack.py -v. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and Owner credentials from test_credentials field.
